secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Your Supabase project URL (e.g. https://yourproject.supabase.co). Find it in your Supabase dashboard under Project Settings > API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Your Supabase service_role key (server-side only, bypasses RLS). Find it in your Supabase dashboard under Project Settings > API > service_role secret.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Your Supabase anon public key (safe for frontend realtime subscriptions). Find it in your Supabase dashboard under Project Settings > API > anon public.

secrets.name: QR_JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Minimum 32-character random secret used to sign QR tokens. A development placeholder is in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real random secret for production.
